about: Pradaxa (dabigatran) and Cardizem CD (diltiazem) are supplied together every month from November 2025 to August 2026, and both appear by brand name only.

Verapamil (Isoptin SR) is supplied four times from December 2025 to March 2026, in the middle of a 14-month history, while dabigatran (Pradaxa) is supplied throughout; dabigatran with verapamil also meets STOPP-C14, because verapamil is a P-glycoprotein inhibitor named by that criterion, so the overlap is listed here as a second finding.

Cardizem CD (diltiazem) is supplied every month with an anticoagulant, but the anticoagulant is warfarin (Marevan), a vitamin K antagonist and not a direct thrombin inhibitor, and no dabigatran is supplied.
